subject: Cedarline MSA redline: propose call to align and onboard next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tony Kim <tony.kim@cedarlinehealth.com>, Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@cedarlinehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cedarline MSA redline: propose call to align and onboard next steps

Hi Tony / Sarah —

Thanks again for the time last week. We reviewed your redline and want to run a short alignment call to: (1) walk through the outstanding clauses in the MSA, (2) agree on the path to execution (DocuSign vs. counter-signed PDF), and (3) confirm the onboarding cadence so our CS team can schedule the technical kickoff.

Attached is our latest consolidated redline (Cedarline_MSA_redline_v3.pdf) with a few inline notes. Would any of these windows work for a 45-minute sync (PST):
- Wed Nov 5, 10:30–11:15 AM PT
- Thu Nov 6, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

If neither fits, propose a couple of times you prefer and we’ll do our best to accommodate. Vanessa (legal ops) will run the call; Marissa (CS) will join for onboarding items.

Agenda (draft):
- Quick intros and objectives (5m)
- Clause walkthrough: data handling, retention & SLA language (25m)
- Execution path and timeline (10m)
- Next steps + owner assignments (5m)

Thanks — look forward to locking a time.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Legal Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Cedarline_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (annotated consolidation)

From: Tony Kim <tony.kim@cedarlinehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@cedarlinehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cedarline MSA redline: propose call to align and onboard next steps

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the consolidated draft. Quick heads up: our procurement review runs Tuesday morning and a bunch of stakeholders are blocked for the rest of the week except for late afternoons. Would you be open to shifting to next week? We can do Mon Nov 10 or Tue Nov 11, 4:00–4:45 PM PT. If it helps, Sarah (legal) can do an earlier window on Tue 11/4 at 6:30 PM PT but that’s outside the team’s preferred hours.

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood intends to push the data-retention objective into a separate Annex or keep it in the main MSA? That will help Sarah prep.

Thanks —
Tony
Tony Kim
Sr. Procurement Manager | Cedarline Health
tony.kim@cedarlinehealth.com
+1 (617) 555-3321

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tony Kim <tony.kim@cedarlinehealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cedarline MSA redline: propose call to align and onboard next steps

Tony —

Thanks for the note. We can absolutely move the call to the week of Nov 10. Hannah — we recommend locking Mon Nov 10, 4:00–4:45 PM PT to keep things compact and give Cedarline time to finish procurement review. Marissa, can you confirm CS availability for that slot?

On the data-retention point: Redwood typically keeps retention language in the main MSA but we can add a short Annex that enumerates data types and retention periods if Cedarline prefers a separate schedule — happy to discuss on the call.

Also, FYI: we’ll bring the DocuSign envelope template to the meeting so we can confirm execution flow (signature order, witness if required).

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Hannah / Vanessa —

Mon Nov 10 at 4:00 PM PT works for me. Thanks for offering the Annex option — Cedarline legal prefers retention called out as a short Annex, but we’ll confirm specifics during the meeting. I’m attaching an annotated version with a few comments on liability clauses and the indemnity text so we can triage quickly: Cedarline_MSA_annotated_by_sarah.pdf.

Agenda request: please include a 5-minute slot at the end to confirm who will own the change log and when the final signed MSA will be circulated.

See you Monday —
Sarah Lewis
General Counsel | Cedarline Health
sarah.lewis@cedarlinehealth.com

Great — Monday Nov 10, 4:00–4:45 PM PT is confirmed. I’ve sent a calendar invite (Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example) and attached the two documents we’ll reference. Quick pre-read notes:
- Vanessa will run the clause walk and manage the change-log owner assignment.
- Sarah’s annotated file is received; we’ll triage indemnity first, then retention Annex.
- Marissa will outline onboarding milestones and the technical kickoff timeline.

Action items before the call:
- Tony / Cedarline: confirm any additional internal stakeholders who should attend (procurement/IT security).
- Sarah: flag any non-negotiable redlines in your annotated PDF so we can prioritize.
- Redwood: we will prepare a draft Annex for retention by EOD Fri Nov 7 and circulate via Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Ccedarline-msaredline
